chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about a man who is in debt, borrows, and performs hajj.
So he said: “Yes, it is more conducive to settling the debt.”

key_terms.أَقْضَى: more conducive to fulfillment or repayment
key_terms.ذِي دَيْنٍ: one who is burdened with debt
key_terms.لِلدَّيْنِ: for the debt; in relation to repaying what is owed
key_terms.يَسْتَدِينُ: he borrows or takes on a loan

ai.seo_question: Can a person in debt borrow money to perform hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a debtor who borrows in order to perform hajj may do so. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام answers affirmatively, indicating that this may be more conducive to the repayment of the debt.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2233 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about a man in debt who borrows money to perform Hajj.
Imam (as) said: "Yes, it is more likely to help him repay his debt."
